name: dsh-skin-studio
description: Skin Studio for DeepSeek Harness: a model-facing skin_studio tool that lets the agent design and one-click install launcher or frontend skins on user request — with a guided flow (ask requirements first; request an image from the user when the model cannot generate one, or call an image-generation tool when it can), local image inlining as data URIs, and instant apply through the DSH Launcher API.
